question: 'Au' is the symbol for which of the following elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **symbol "Au" represents the element gold**
 
• **Gold's name comes from** the Latin word aurum, which means "shining dawn". 
 
• Gold is a** dense, soft, malleable, and ductile transition metal with an atomic number of 79.**
 
• In its pure form, it is unreactive and has a bright, slightly orange-yellow colour.&am
